title: Merge pending c7dc67a bootstrap-audio commit
acceptance: The already-DEPLOYED MP bootstrap-audio commit lands on main via the merge-queue (known-good warm-up). Full native gate green; main advances; deployed app == main.
notes: Special: branch already exists (the deployed playtest commit, not on main). The loop creates a worktree FROM this branch, runs the native gate, and merges — proving the merge-queue end-to-end before any new implementation.

title: Escape-listener overlay-stack fix
acceptance: A shared useEscapeStack so Esc closes only the TOPMOST overlay; lower overlays unaffected. vitest + e2e green; tsc clean.
notes: Many overlays (PianoRoll, DrumWindow, PluginBrowser, modals) each register an Escape handler independently; co-open would double-close. Fast cheap-lane win that proves the loop.

title: Per-template rebind persistence
acceptance: User keybind rebinds persist per template to localStorage and round-trip across reload. UI-local (no backend command). vitest round-trip test green.
notes: keymap.ts + settings store already exist; this adds per-template persistence of rebinds.

title: LoRA popover progress/error UI
acceptance: The WIP LoRA training popover shows progress + error states driven by existing /training/* snapshot fields. vitest green; tsc clean.
notes: Backend /training/* + commands exist; only the popover's progress/error surface is missing. The REAL training backend stays an excluded epic — this is the shippable UI slice.

title: Prompt-concision rewriter (service)
acceptance: A deterministic, stdlib-only prompt-concision rewriter in the service (05 §6). Never touches the command surface. Python unit test proves before/after concision deterministically.
notes: Optional non-blocking add. Pure-Python, cheap-class (no adapters/colors/sa3).

title: Multiplayer relay hardening
acceptance: Self-host stdlib relay gains rate-limiting, a slow-POST body cap, and lock-lease GC. relay/test_*.py green. (Supabase-SQL-on-a-live-project parts split out as needs-human.)
notes: relay/ is pure-Python stdlib with existing tests. SQL TOCTOU / Supabase migration parts touch the exclusion list → those become separate human-gated items.

title: Judge-panel quality readout
acceptance: The Audiobox judge's reasoning surfaces alongside pq/pq_base in the generative drawer. Manifest side feeds verify.py → full native gate. Native gate green.
notes: 05 §7. The manifest/quality side feeds verify.py fingerprints → native-class. A pure-TS readout panel could be split into a separate cheap item.

title: Recent-projects list
acceptance: An open-recent command + snapshot field + UI list; relaunch can open a recent project (not only the fixed session). New selftest section. Native gate green ×3 deterministic.
notes: Smallest native item — proves the native lane. NOTE: MoshEngine.cpp is on the hard-exclusion list; if the implementation must edit it, this item gets a PR but is human-gated. Prefer adding the surface in MoshOps + a new engine helper file to stay auto-mergeable.

title: bypass_layer real audio re-route
acceptance: cmdBypassLayer actually routes the ORIGINAL (pre-render) audio when bypassed, not just flips a ValueTree flag. A new verify.py A/B check proves bypassed == original (diff-RMS from the rendered layer). Native gate green ×3.
notes: Confirmed real bug: cmdBypassLayer (~MoshOps.cpp:4822/4827) only sets a status flag; the clip still plays the rendered layer. Highest-value native fix.

title: Save-As audio consolidation / portability
acceptance: Save-As consolidates render artifacts + repaths cacheArtifact relatively so freeze_layer / re-accept survive a project move. A portability check mirroring check_relative_ref_export proves it. Native gate green.
notes: Deferred B1 from the prior campaign. NOTE: likely edits MoshEngine.cpp (hard-excluded) → may become human-gated; prefer isolating the consolidation in a helper. Larger; consider decomposing.
